actions.reason: Training tie-break scans got cheaper; the chosen pair is unchanged. RegexTokenizer.train: every chunk that holds a candidate pair is listed in that pair's where set, so the scan for the first candidate now starts at the smallest such chunk index instead of chunk 0. BasicTokenizer.train: the first-candidate scan uses next(filter(cands.__contains__, zip(...))), which runs in C, instead of a Python loop. Also, chunk multiplicities are counted with _count_elements. Equivalence identical; train_ir ratio 0.9813; all tests pass.
